headline: Congress named a South Carolina post office in Fort Mill after J. Elliott Williams.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 201 Tom Hall Street in Fort Mill, South Carolina, as the "J. Elliott Williams Post Office Building." It only changes the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on July 24, 2018.
